visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Missing break Falls Through
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Adding 6 and 3 should print 9, but the program prints 3 because more than one case runs.

solution.explanation: Without break, execution falls through into the next case label and keeps running. After result = a + b the code also ran case '-' (result = a - b = 3) and only stopped at that case's break. End every case with break.
